meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 编码前产出决策完备的实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不先理清方案就写代码总返工。
copy.tagline_en: Produce a decision-complete work plan before coding.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear work plan before starting implementation.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 先做只读调研,再把模糊或很大的需求写成一份“决策完备”的工作计划:步骤、路径、分工都写清,执行者不用再追问就能照做。它只写计划文件,绝不改代码或动手实施;实施要等你另行发令(如 /ulw-execute)启动。
howto.when: 只在你说清要走 ulw-plan 流程、或要求动手前先出计划时触发;单纯说“跑一下 ulw”这类话不会自动激活。一旦激活,就一直停在规划模式,不转入实施。

say.text: 先别写代码:给登录接口加限流,走 ulw-plan 出一份实施计划。
say.note: 它会先宣布进入规划模式,只做调研,不碰代码。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 把“改造认证模块”展开成可执行计划。
say.note: 落笔前它会先给结论并要你确认。

say.text: 先规划再动手:给 /login 加每 IP 每分钟 5 次限流,输出计划。
say.note: 产出是一份带待办清单的计划文件。

howto.what_en: Explores read-only first, then writes one decision-complete work plan a worker can run with no further interview. It never edits code — only plan files; implementation starts only via your separate /ulw-execute launch.
howto.when_en: Fires only on an explicit ulw-plan request or a 'plan before implementation' ask; a bare 'run ulw' never self-activates it. Once active it stays in sticky plan mode and does not start implementing.

say_en.text: Don't code yet — draft a ulw-plan for rate-limiting the login endpoint.
say_en.note: Announces plan mode, then only explores read-only.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan: break 'rework the auth module' into an executable work plan.
say_en.note: Announces an intent verdict (clear or unclear) up front.

say_en.text: Plan first: add a 5/min-per-IP rate limit to /login, then output the plan.
say_en.note: You get a plan file listing tasks and recommended executors.
